title: Release-order opening-follower print drift (US-anchored monthly print sequence, order-state conditioned on the early-printing economy's own pair, vintaged first prints, PIT-gated entry, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for this cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned P0 census, the P1 spot grid census and the family-failure inventory was consumed; all order-state counts above were measured from publication instants only (never from print values).

mechanism.story: Each calendar month the same-coverage CPI print set publishes in a sequence: the US benchmark print first (measured: strictly first in 77 of 85 months), then the non-US prints over the following ~2-3 weeks. The FIRST non-US print of the month - the OPENING FOLLOWER - is the market's first same-coverage cross-check of the month's US anchor. With only two datapoints in the month's inflation state (US anchor + opener), conservative slow money under-reacts at arrival and waits for the confirming follower prints before implementing; their delayed implementation lands weeks later, inside the window this lane can provably observe. Later follower prints arrive into an increasingly triangulated state (3+ same-coverage datapoints); their naive-predictor deviations are dominated by the already-priced common component and their late windows are informationally thin. The ORDER of release, not the print event itself, allocates the persistent diffusion across pairs.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) monthly dealing-cycle benchmark rebalancers and calendar-fixing corporate hedgers implement inflation-view updates only at scheduled windows - structurally late relative to the intra-month release sequence; (ii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: the evidenced value availability (vintaged channel) is median 24 days after publication for GB/CA/NZ (15-16 for AU), and the measured entry is median 28 days after the opening print's publication, so every entry is necessarily weeks late. The hypothesis is specifically that the opening-order-conditioned repricing SURVIVES the PIT-provable availability lag plus the holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_it_might_exist: Information SEQUENCING is not priced efficiently at the slow horizon: the same print deviation is more informative when it is first in the monthly release sequence than when it is third or fourth, but slow participants' attention and dealing calendars are not order-sensitive. That mismatch creates order-dependent diffusion lags. The claimed edge source is the relative ORDER of releases (a calendar-invisible-to-slow-money structure), NOT the sign of the release (that class is closed on both sides of the economy boundary, see ancestry_defense) and NOT any yield or price level (V8 law).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (after-cost per-trade expectancy <= 0) if opening-follower months' late windows are as empty as everyone else's. It must die by falsification if the SAME reaction-direction form fired WITHOUT the order-state (the mandatory V7-ancestry control: all non-US prints, own pair, same clock) reproduces the anchor - then the order filter carries nothing and the book is V7 re-clocked; if a nominal-yield-level exposure reproduces it (V8 law); if a constant-direction calendar shadow reproduces it (Q-7); if a randomly shuffled order-state selection reproduces it (placebo); or at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full failure inventory (accepted in advance).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: (a) evidenced monthly print PUBLICATION ORDER from the pinned announcement census (census sha256 e8a35d23ce64ce71a8d30792750b877c387de3692af1e4d17391ea4cc35b4abe, re-measured at this checkout); (b) realized vintaged CPI first-print index levels vs a frozen seasonal-naive predictor computed from the same vintaged archive (identical formula class as lane A4-P1, frozen independently here). NO consensus/forecast data anywhere (plan section 9).

order_construction.month_grouping: calendar month of the evidenced (local) publication date - the release-calendar month; all prints of a month cover the same inflation window: GB/CA monthly prints cover reference month M-1, AU/NZ quarterly prints cover the quarter ENDING M-1 (census reference_period label = the quarter's first month)
order_construction.interval_order_rule: ordering uses P-1-evidenced publication instants ONLY: exact-time instants (CA 12:30Z, NZ Auckland 10:45 DST-corrected) are points; DATE_ONLY evidence (GB, AU, US) is a full-day uncertainty interval [00:00Z, 23:59:59Z]; X strictly-precedes Y iff X's latest possible instant < Y's earliest possible instant; anything else is UNPROVABLE ORDER and fails closed
order_construction.us_anchored_month: a month is US-ANCHORED iff the US same-coverage print strictly precedes EVERY non-US print of that month under the interval rule; non-anchored months are excluded (no state)
order_construction.opening_follower: the OPENING FOLLOWER (OF) is the unique non-US print that strictly precedes every other non-US print of a US-anchored month; months without a provable unique OF are NO-STATE and excluded (fail-closed)

measured_order_census.non_anchored_detail: 2 months with a CA print before the US print (2018-10, 2019-03); 6 months with a GB print tying the US date (date-only evidence both sides, order unprovable)
measured_order_census.AU_note: AU never opens: it publishes day 25-31, after every other same-coverage print (measured US-to-AU gap 13-20 days)
measured_order_census.no_unique_OF_cause: CA exact-time instants fall INSIDE GB date-only windows (same local date) - order unprovable, fail-closed
measured_order_census.binary_vs_US_degeneracy_disclosed: the naive binary 'non-US prints before US' clock is measured DEGENERATE (2 events in 7 years); the viable order structure is the post-US release sequence, of which the opening follower is the first element

information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor: I_hat_sn(m) = I(m-1) * ( I(m-12) / I(m-13) ), where I(k) is the vintaged index level for month k in the vintage in force at the decision instant (point-in-time read of the vintaged series, never a later revision).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor_name: seasonal-naive one-step (last-year same-month seasonal ratio applied to the latest vintaged level)
information_source_and_surprise_construc.surprise: s1 = 100 * ( I_print(m) / I_hat_sn(m) - 1 ), in percentage points of index deviation, of the OPENING print only.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.i_print_source: vintaged_first_value of the pinned census first-release instant (the value as first carried by the evidenced vintaged channel).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.pit_rule: All predictor inputs I(m-1), I(m-12), I(m-13) are read as-of the decision instant (the vintage in force then); I_print is the first-release vintaged value; the order state (US-anchored + unique OF) is determined exclusively by publication-instant evidence dated at or before the opening print's publication - public calendar information provably known before entry; no value that entered its vintage after the decision instant may be read (P-1..P-6 chain; ONE_EVENT_LAG impossible by construction).

frozen_parameters.neighbour_parameterization: opener-or-co-opener order construction: fires additionally on ALL provable co-earliest prints of the 27 no-unique-OF months (54 extra events; same |s1| >= 0.10 gate, same direction law, H = 5; total 104 events)
frozen_parameters.threshold_selection_basis: blind frozen priors chosen before any outcome; no tuning permitted after any number is seen (P-15)

universe.event_instrument_law: each OF event of economy X fires on X's OWN pair only (1 pair-decision per event); later follower prints of the month generate no position anywhere in this proposal.
universe.direction_law: s1 >= +0.10 => long the funded-economy currency vs USD (GB: long GBPUSD; CA: short USDCAD; AU: long AUDUSD; NZ: long NZDUSD). s1 <= -0.10 => the mirror. |s1| < 0.10 => no position. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias.

ancestry_defense.v7_reaction_direction_closed_SPECIFIC: FOREX-FREE-V7 closed the reaction-direction class 'on both sides of the economy boundary': FXFV7-A4-P1 (cross-economy release-sign spillover on non-reporting pairs) died mechanically AND by falsification-by-control cluster #12 (the +7d sham reproduced the anchor, so the calendar conditioning carried no incremental information); FXFV7-A6-P2 (cross-pair lead-lag diffusion) died with the own-lag control OUT-earning it; FOREX-FREE-V6's own-economy reaction-direction died on robustness. This lane differs STRUCTURALLY: (i) direction is a magnitude-bearing naive-predictor DEVIATION, not the sign of the release; (ii) entry is strictly after PIT-provable vintaged availability (measured median 28 days after the opening print's publication) - a horizon V6/V7 never represented (they entered at publication); (iii) LOAD-BEARING: every fill is selected by the ORDER STATE (US-anchored month + provably-unique opening follower), a variable that does not exist in any V6/V7 construction. The distinction is ALSO measured, twice: the mandatory CTL-V7RECAP runs the identical form with the order-state removed (kill at >= 0.5x same-sign per-trade), and D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 applies vs the full inventory including the V6 anchor book and both V7 books; over the bar => lane dies at D2 (accepted in advance).
ancestry_defense.v8_nominal_level_law: V8 falsification-by-control #14 made a nominal-exposure control MANDATORY on every yield/inflation lane. Carried as CTL-DGS10LEVEL on the identical clock; no nominal yield level enters the signal. If the control reproduces the anchor, the family is dead by law.
ancestry_defense.v9_ppp_vetoes: V9 A5-P1/P2 died as PPP/real-rate LEVEL-misalignment books (rho 0.3034/0.3119 vs the V8 anchor). This proposal carries no PPP, real-rate, or level-misalignment state anywhere; conditioning is event-time order structure, two-sided, deviation-gated. D2 rho gate vs the V9 veto books applies.
ancestry_defense.v5_sham_calendar_standard: order-state placebo carried (PLACEBO-ORDSHUF), the V5-era house standard adapted to the order axis: marginal fired-count preserved, order information destroyed.
ancestry_defense.v3_pit_chain: P-1..P-6 incident chain honored: interval-aware ordering asserts 'before' ONLY when provable (date-only evidence = full-day uncertainty; same-date exact-vs-date-only = fail-closed), conservative end-of-day availability bounds, as-of vintage reads, fill validator refuses any conditioning instant or value that postdates the decision.
ancestry_defense.v9_high_finding_binding: non-US legs come ONLY from the vintaged channel (pinned sha256s above); current-vintage revised-in-place tables are FORBIDDEN for GB/CA legs (and all non-US legs).
